description:
Cast Ravenous Rotbelly by paying its mana cost.
When Ravenous Rotbelly enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When Ravenous Rotbelly dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Ravenous Rotbelly that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Ravenous Rotbelly token instead.
